articles.title: US stocks: S&P closes at record high as soft jobs report eases rate-hike concerns

Meanwhile, a dip in oil prices, influenced by advancing peace talks, helped to soothe inflation fears.

articles.title: Oil minister Hardeep Singh Puri dismisses concerns about fuel adulteration
articles.description: Hardeep Singh Puri addressed the issue of fuel adulteration, asserting that concerns over it are baseless. A nationwide investigation uncovered only four instances at various petrol stations. He emphasized that oil marketing firms implement strict testing protocols. Analysis results indicate that chloride levels remain safe and do not support allegations of excessive chloride presence.
